 JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e
 WHERE st.store_id<>999),
rets AS (
 SELECT per.fiscal_year fy, c.cur_cat cat, p.category hist_cat, -f.refund_net amt
 FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku

 WHERE st.store_id<>999),
u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)

 round(100.0*(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2025/26' THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2024/25' THEN amt END)-1),2) g
FROM u WHERE cat IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
